steps.describes: Prepares the THP-102 crossover data: absolute dose in mg, food and period as factors.
steps.rationale: Adapted from the THP-101 prepare script so that both studies' pk.csv read the same way.

claims.why: prepare script adapted from the THP-101 analysis

steps.describes: NCA per subject and period: Cmax, Tmax, AUC to the last sample (linear trapezoid).
steps.rationale: The food effect is judged on AUC and Cmax per period, as the protocol says.

steps.describes: Food effect: geometric mean ratio fed/fasted of AUClast and Cmax with 90 % confidence intervals.
steps.rationale: Within-subject log differences of the crossover; 90 % intervals as for a bioequivalence judgement (0.80–1.25).

claims.why: AUC unchanged by food (GMR 0.98, 0.95–1.01); Cmax 9 % lower (0.91, 0.86–0.96)

steps.describes: Population model of both periods: one compartment (SSfol) with food on the absorption rate.
steps.rationale: Explains the lower Cmax: food slows absorption (Ka fed/fasted 0.47) without changing clearance.

claims.why: food on Ka explains the Cmax difference
